titel: Operation Mincemeat | Hook, Line and Sinker | 3

einzeiler: How a deceptive corpse and a stolen briefcase helped the Allies turn the tide of WWII.
kurzfassung: British intelligence attempts to convince Nazi Germany that Allied forces will invade Greece instead of Sicily by planting a disguised corpse with fake documents. German spy Karl-Erich Kuhlenthal infiltrates Spanish archives to photograph the confidential letters, falling directly into the elaborate trap. Adolf Hitler orders troops away from Sicily, allowing the Allied amphibious assault to successfully breach the Axis defenses.
stichpunkte: The British plan to mask the impending invasion of Sicily by planting a dead body carrying false invasion documents in Spain.
Adolf Hitler reels from severe military losses across multiple fronts while seeking refuge in his private alpine cinema.
German intelligence officer Karl-Erich Kuhlenthal breaks into a Spanish mortuary and naval headquarters to photograph the secret letters.
Ewan Montagu uses eyelashes as a clever tamper indicator to confirm that the sensitive documents have indeed been read.
Hitler recalls past intelligence failures and decides to trust the captured papers, ordering troops to reinforce Greece instead of Sicily.
Winston Churchill briefly panics upon learning of German reinforcements before receiving confirmation of the successful double bluff.
Allied forces land on the beaches of Sicily facing surprisingly light resistance as the Axis defenses crumble.
The successful deception operation breaks the Axis hold on Europe and paves the way for ultimate Allied victory.
beschreibung:
British intelligence have a peculiar problem: they need a German spy to steal a briefcase, whilst making it look like they're trying to stop him. But when Abwehr agent Kühlenthal finally takes the bait, will Hitler actually fall for it?
